people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: As for the people, he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it.
translations.bsb: and Joseph reduced the people to servitude from one end of Egypt to the other.
translations.kjv: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end
translations.asv: And as for the people, he removed them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end thereof.
